Senior Quality Consultant  
  Lead transformational quality initiatives in a growing, highly regulated manufacturing environment.  
 Are you an experienced Quality professional who enjoys building systems, driving compliance, and delivering meaningful organisational change? 
 Hoban Recruitment is partnering with a leading Australian manufacturing business to recruit a  Senior Quality Consultant  for a newly created 12-month contract. This is an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in strengthening quality systems, improving compliance frameworks, and supporting a business undergoing significant transformation. 
 Based in  Carrum Downs , this position offers the opportunity to influence strategic quality outcomes while working closely with senior leadership. 
 The Opportunity 
 This is not a traditional Quality Assurance role. 
 You'll be the most senior quality specialist onsite, taking a consultative and advisory approach to reviewing existing systems, identifying opportunities for improvement, and implementing sustainable quality and compliance frameworks across the business. 
 Working alongside an established QA team, you'll provide technical leadership, mentor team members, and partner with stakeholders to ensure quality systems meet both customer and regulatory expectations. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 
 Conduct a comprehensive review and gap analysis of existing quality and compliance systems 
 
 
 Assess current processes against future business and regulatory requirements 
 
 
 Identify compliance risks and recommend practical improvement strategies 
 
 
 Develop and deliver an implementation roadmap for quality system enhancements 
 
 
 Lead quality improvement projects over a nine-month implementation period 
 
 
 Build, improve and standardise quality management systems, policies and procedures 
 
 
 Support customer audits and ensure ongoing regulatory compliance 
 
 
 Investigate customer quality concerns and oversee corrective and preventative actions (CAPA) 
 
 
 Provide coaching and technical guidance to the Quality team 
 
 
 Partner with operational leaders to embed continuous improvement and quality best practice 
 
 
 About You 
 You are a strategic quality professional who enjoys solving complex problems, influencing stakeholders, and building quality systems that create lasting business improvement. 
 To be successful, you'll ideally bring: 
 
 
 Extensive experience within Quality Assurance, Quality Systems or Compliance 
 
 
 Strong knowledge of GMP and quality management systems 
 
 
 Proven experience conducting quality gap analyses and implementing improvement programs 
 
 
 Experience interpreting quality standards and translating them into practical business processes 
 
 
 Strong auditing capability across GMP and/or ISO environments 
 
 
 Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills 
 
 
 Experience working with regulated customers and managing customer audits 
 
 
 A tertiary qualification in Science, Quality, Technical or a related discipline 
 
 
 Experience using PECS (essential) 
 
 
 Highly regarded: 
 
 
 Pharmaceutical manufacturing experience 
 
 
 Clean room manufacturing environments 
 
 
 Textile, garment or industrial manufacturing experience 
 
 
 Experience within highly regulated industries 
 
 
 What's on Offer 
 
 
  $120,000-$150,000 + Super  
 
 
 12-month fixed-term contract with genuine potential for permanency 
 
 
 Newly created position with significant autonomy and influence 
 
 
 Opportunity to lead business-wide quality transformation projects 
 
 
 Supportive leadership team committed to continuous improvement 
 
 
 Work within a well-established organisation experiencing strong growth and positive organisational change 
 
 
 Make a genuine impact while helping shape the future of the business 
 
 
 Apply Now 
 If you're an experienced quality professional looking to step into a strategic role where you can drive meaningful change and leave a lasting legacy, we'd love to hear from you. 
 Apply today with your resume or contact the Hoban Recruitment team for a confidential discussion. 
   

 At HOBAN we encourage applications from people with disability, people from diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds, people of all genders, LGBTI people, and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people. 
 We provide reasonable adjustments; including alternate formats to the recruitment process for individuals with disability. If you require an adjustment to be made during the recruitment process, please email our Adjustments Coordinator at  adjustments@hoban.com.au  or visit  hoban.com.au/adjustments  for additional contact details.  Please  click here  to apply.

VeiraMal Consulting is seeking an experienced Motor Mechanic to join Solution Dash Auto Care in Dandenong. Our client is looking for an enthusiastic individual who can work well in a team, with strong communication skills.

Summary:

We are seeking a skilled and reliable Vehicle Motor Mechanic to join our team. The role involves diagnosing, repairing, and servicing a wide range of vehicles, ensuring high-quality workmanship and customer satisfaction. Key tasks include conducting routine maintenance, identifying mechanical issues, using diagnostic equipment, and performing repairs in line with safety and manufacturer standards. The ideal candidate will have proven experience, strong problem-solving skills, and a commitment to delivering excellent service.

Key Responsibilities:

- Inspecting vehicle engine and mechanical/electrical components to diagnose issues accurately
- Inspecting vehicle computer and electronic components to repair, maintain, and upgrade systems
- Conducting routine maintenance work such as replacing fluids, lubricating parts, and adjusting components aiming to vehicle functionality and longevity 
- Troubleshooting issues and fixing them aiming to maximum reliability and functionality
- Schedule future maintenance sessions and advise motorists about good vehicle usage
- Repair or replace broken of faulty parts and fix issues
- Provide accurate estimates (cost, time, effort) for a repair or maintenance job
- Keep work and issue logs
- Maintain tools and equipment in good working condition
- Perform routine automotive maintenance tasks, including fluid changes, tyre replacements, suspension/steering repairs, and OBD scanning
- Must be willing to upskill and keep working knowledge of current industry best practices in automotive repair
- Conduct extensive diagnostic procedures to determine the sources of customer problems and provide accurate repair recommendations
- Inspect vehicles according to the state's requirements for emissions and safety
- Conduct necessary repairs and take vehicles for test drives to verify soundness
- Maintain legible and accurate paperwork for both the customer and company records
- Clean and maintain the work environment to ensure equipment longevity and workplace safety

Performance Appraisal: Three months after the starting date, then half yearly or when required.

Qualification & Requirements:

- Provide Relevant Qualifications
- Effectively use hand tools and diagnostic equipment
- Able to handle hazardous materials safely and tolerate exposure to electrical hazards
- Able to perform heavy physical labour
- Great attentions to details
- No skin allergies or reactions to grease, oil or petrol
- Flexible hours available
- 1 year of relevant work experience required for this role
- RWC license not required but is an advantage

Remuneration: $75,000.00 - $85,000.00 + Super

Location: 4/9 Brooklyn Avenue, Dandenong 3175

If you are interested and think you will be a good fit for this role, please apply.

Salary $75,000 - $90,000
Maroochydore Qld

About the role
Pacific Motor Group is seeking an experienced Parts Retail Manager to join our dynamic team.

As the Parts Retail Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations of our parts department, ensuring efficient inventory management, exceptional customer service, and the development of a high-performing team. This full-time role is a critical position within our organisation, contributing to the overall success of our automotive business.

What you'll be doing
Manage the parts department, including inventory control, stock replenishment, and pricing strategies
Provide exceptional customer service, handling enquiries and orders in a timely and professional manner
Lead, coach, and motivate a team of parts specialists, fostering a positive and productive work environment
Develop and implement strategies to grow parts sales and increase customer loyalty
Prepare and analyse department reports, identifying opportunities for improvement and driving operational efficiencies
Ensure compliance with all relevant industry regulations and company policies
Collaborate with the wider Pacific Motor Group team to achieve overall business objectives

What we're looking for
Extensive experience (5+ years) in a parts retail or automotive parts management role
Proven track record of leading and motivating a high-performing team
Excellent customer service skills and the ability to build strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders
Proficient in inventory management, stock control, and parts ordering systems
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and implement process improvements
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Relevant industry qualifications or certifications are highly desirable

What we offer
At Pacific Motor Group, we are committed to providing our employees with a rewarding and fulfilling work experience. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a range of benefits, including:
Opportunities for career development and progression
Ongoing training and development programs
Discounts on parts and services for personal vehicles
Flexible work arrangements and a supportive work-life balance
A positive and collaborative team environment
If you are a driven and experienced Parts Retail Manager who is passionate about the automotive industry, and an excellent opportunity for the right individual. We encourage you to APPLY NOW

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted

We are seeking a qualified and experienced Light Vehicle Mechanic with strong skills in diagnostics, fault-finding, servicing, and mechanical repairs.

The ideal candidate will have experience working on a wide range of light vehicles and be confident using diagnostic equipment to identify and resolve faults. They should be reliable, detail-oriented, and able to work independently while maintaining high standards of workmanship and safety. Strong communication skills, a positive attitude, and a commitment to delivering quality service are essential.

Your role will include, but is not limited to:
- Diagnose and identify mechanical, electrical and electronic faults in light vehicles using specialised diagnostic equipment and manufacturer specifications to determine appropriate repair solutions.

differentials, braking components, suspension assemblies, steering systems, cooling systems and exhaust systems.
- Inspect, dismantle, repair and reassemble engines, transmissions, steering, suspension, braking, cooling and driveline systems, ensuring all components meet manufacturer and workshop quality standards.
- Conduct engine diagnostics, electronic fuel injection (EFI) repairs, engine management system testing and fault rectification using computer-based diagnostic equipment.
- Carry out engine overhauls, engine conversions and other mechanical upgrades for light vehicles, ensuring all work is completed safely and in accordance with engineering and workshop specifications.

- Test, adjust and inspect repaired or serviced vehicles through workshop testing and road testing to verify performance, drivability and compliance with operational and safety requirements.
- Assist with custom vehicle builds by carrying out mechanical installation, fitting and assembly work in collaboration with fabrication and auto electrical teams.
- Inspect vehicles for mechanical condition, identify repair requirements, provide accurate recommendations for additional maintenance where necessary, and maintain detailed service records in accordance with workshop procedures and regulatory requirements.

Applicants must have:
- Relevant trade qualification AQF Certificate IV with at least one year of relevant experience. Alternatively, at least three years of full-time relevant experience in lieu of a formal qualification.
- Strong diagnostic and fault-finding skills using modern diagnostic equipment.
- Effective communication skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team.

In joining us, you'll benefit from long-term, stable employment with opportunities to develop advanced skills in diagnostics, automotive electrical systems, engine conversions, and vehicle modifications. The role offers varied and challenging work, ongoing training, and the potential to progress into a Senior Technician or Workshop Leadership position.

A salary of $79,000 - $95,000 will be offered to the successful candidate.
